maddeler.t: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish پیشرو (peşrev, “forerunner; prelude, overture”), the first part being Persian پیش (piš, “fore-”), the latter part رو (rav) used in formed words meaning “something that goes”.
s: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish پیشرو (peşrev, “forerunner; prelude, overture”)
g: bashraf, an instrumental music form in Arabic music
